scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with a statue of a man and a cow atop a large stone pedestal in the middle of the street. The street is paved and has a sidewalk on either side. There are several trees planted along the sidewalk, as well as some benches and trash cans. A few people are walking down the street, including a woman in a white coat and a man in dark clothing. In the distance, there are several buildings, including a tall white building with many windows. The sky is blue with some clouds.
